page.layout: One page of verse in the main column; marginal notes in the left margin beside the lines. Running head at top with page number 234 at upper left.

p.i: Nescius heu, quanti thalamos ascendere monstri
Arserit, atque urbes maneat quis terror Achaas,
Gratior ipse deis, orbâque beatior aula.
Proxima Bisaltae regio, ductorque Colaxes
Sanguis & ipse deum, Scythicis quem Iupiter oris
Progenuit, viridem Miracen, Tibisenaque iuxta
Ostia, semifero (dignum si credere) captus
Corpore, nec Nympha gemínos exhorruit angues.
Cunctaque phalanx, insigne Iouis, celataque gestat
Tegmina, dispersos trifidis ardoribus ignes:
Necprimus radios, miles Romane, coruscì
Fulminis, & rutilas scutis diffunderis alas.
Insuper auratos collegerat ipse dracones
Matris Horae specimen, linguisque aduersus utrimque
Congruit, & tereti serpens dat vulnera gemma.
Tertius vnanimis veniens cum millibus Auchus
Cimmerias ostentat opes, cui candidus olim
Crinis ineft, natale decus: dat longior aetas
Iam spacium. Triplici percurrens tempora nodo
Dimittit sacro geminas a vertice vittas.
Dathin Achamenia grauior de vulnere pugna.
Misit in arma Darabs, aciesque quem Martia circum
Gangaridum, potaque Gerys quos efferat vnda,
Quique lacum cinxere Bicen: non defuit Anxur,
Non Radalo cum fratre Fidon: Iucesinaque lauo
Omine, fatidica Phrygus mouet agmina cerua.
Ipsa comes, sectis fulgens, & cornibus aureis,
Ante aciem celsi vehitur gestamine conti,
Maeta necis saeua luco reditura Diana.
Monit & Hylaea supplex cum gente Syenem
Impia germani patentans vulnera Persas.
Densior haud vsquam, nec celsior extulit ullas
Sylua trabes, sectis priusquam redisse sagitta,
Arboris

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are geographical place names (Bisaltae pop., Miracae opp., Tebisenus fl., Cimmerij populi, Gangaridae, Gerys fl., Bice lacus, Hylaei pop.); the reading of some marginal abbreviations is uncertain. Scan is faint; several words in the main text are doubtful and may contain errors.
